# Implement m2 - modify TocTreeprocessor.run
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
content = result.stdout

# Find and replace the old pattern
old_code = '''                self.set_level(el)
                text = get_name(el)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    innertext = unescape(stashedHTML2text(text, self.md))
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': unescape(stashedHTML2text(
                            code_escape(el.attrib.get('data-toc-label', text)),
                            self.md, strip_entities=False
                        ))
                    })'''

new_code = '''                self.set_level(el)
                # Use new helpers instead of deprecated get_name/stashedHTML2text
                inner_html = render_inner_html(self.md, el)
                processed_text = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
                text = striptags(processed_text)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(html.unescape(text), self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        name = striptags(raw_label)
                    else:
                        name = text
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name
                    })'''

new_content = content.replace(old_code, new_code)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("m2 changes written")

# Verify
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['sed', '-n', '325,360p', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result2.stdout)
